text:
chris-mkt: Quick brainstorm : launch "ByteBites"  a 4-week micro-tutorial series + 1 tiny OSS refapp per week. each piece: 2-min read, runnable Docker refapp, tiny benchmark card. low friction. thoughts? :chip:
devrel-jo: love. keep CTA 'Run in 5'. include a copy-paste curl + Docker snippet. call out Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private perf.
riley-eng: agree. Refapp constraints: single-file node/python, 3 endpoints: /health /chat /embed. ENV var REDWOOD_API_KEY. single Dockerfile. I'll make the template.
alex-p: I'll scaffold repo + GH Actions: lint, build, bench artifact CSV. add a small action to publish bench CSV on release.
maria-ux: visuals: one compact benchmark card template (p50/p95 + cost/1k) + 6s GIF. keep consistent thumbnail across series.
sam-sales: inbound: blog microform with use-case, company size, demo checkbox. enterprise -> AE queue; community -> nurture. capture timezone for office hours invites.
chris-mkt: bench plan: compare three configs (hosted-small, dedicated-default, private-quantized). metrics: p50, p95, tokens/sec, cost/1k. riley, can you own scripts?
riley-eng: yep. will produce a script to run 256-token workload and output CSV. add a guard to avoid committing keys.
devrel-jo: distribution: blog + tweet thread + community newsletter + small 30s demo clip. week 3 -> 30-min office hours. encourage community PRs with label "bytebites-contrib".
ops-bot: CI checklist created: build -> bench -> publish artifact. Recommend secret-scan enabled.
chris-mkt: timeline (4-week pilot): week0 scaffold + baseline bench; week1 snack #1 publish; week2 snack #2; week3 snack #3 + office hours; week4 community picks + recap.
alex-p: I'll prep the repo template by EOD Tuesday. jo, can you draft Snack #1 copy?
devrel-jo: yes, drafting now. will include a short benchmark card and run snippet.
sam-sales: also propose a short gated demo for enterprise leads: quick form -> AE follow-up. keep main posts ungated for community.
maria-ux: will share GIF and hero variants by Monday for A/B.
chris-mkt: good. assign: riley (bench), alex (repo+CI), jo (content+office hours), maria (visuals), sam (inbound). we'll measure CTR, form conversions, and PRs. launching pilot in 3 weeks. :rocket:
